Alger, 25 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 25, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Huawei Algeria is sending a delegation of thirty Algerian students to China for the tenth edition of the "Seeds for the Future 2026" program, marking ten years of the country's participation in the global initiative. This record number of participants reflects a growing commitment to digital skills and international technology exchanges.
Huawei renforce son partenariat avec l’A: Huawei strengthens its partnership with Algeria to train local ICT talent in China
La filiale algérienne de Huawei lance la: Huawei's Algerian subsidiary is launching the tenth edition of its flagship "Seeds for the Future 2026" program, with a record thirty students selected for a multi-week technology immersion in Shenzhen. This delegation, the largest since the program was launched in Algeria, illustrates the group's commitment to strengthening young people's skills in information and communication technologies (ICT).
Les participants, issus de divers horizo: The participants, from diverse academic backgrounds, will benefit from a program combining theory and practice, including visits to technology facilities, workshops with international experts, and exposure to the latest innovations. The selected students include pupils from the Houari Boumediene University of Science and Technology, the National Higher School of Computer Science (ESI), as well as training programs under the Ministries of Higher Education, Posts and Telecommunications, Interior, and Vocational Training. This diversity reflects Huawei Algeria's ambition to broaden access to learning opportunities across the country's various sectors.
« Seeds for the Future » s’inscrit dans: "Seeds for the Future" is part of Huawei's global strategy to develop digital skills and foster cultural exchanges among young talent worldwide. In Algeria, this initiative aligns with national digital transformation objectives by training a new generation capable of meeting contemporary technological challenges. The program specifically aims to strengthen skills in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, key sectors for the country's economic future.
Pour Huawei Algérie, cette édition marqu: For Huawei Algeria, this edition also marks a symbolic anniversary: ten years of collaboration with Algerian institutions to promote innovation and technological partnerships. The group thus reaffirms its commitment to supporting youth training while consolidating its position as a major player in digital infrastructure in Algeria.
